---
title: "Russian rouble does not trust the government"
description: "The rouble's 2.5% drop right after official reassurances shows how little credibility the Russian government carries with markets."
date: "2023-07-07"
categories: [ukraine, russia-economy]
---

Macroeconomic stability rests on public trust in government, and the rouble's
behaviour is a live gauge of how little Russians extend to theirs: it fell
2.5% immediately after official statements meant to project economic
confidence. A government seen as well-behaved and benevolent earns a form of
soft power that stabilises its currency even through shocks; the Russian
government's credibility deficit means it can't draw on that cushion, however
sound the underlying macro fundamentals look on paper.

**Originally published on Substack**, July 7, 2023.
